entities.name: Uramon
entities.description: A criminal overlord in the Takenuma swamp on Kamigawa, killed by Kiku's camellia.

entities.name: Takenuma
entities.description: Swamp on Kamigawa where Uramon ruled.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: Place where Uramon built her manor.

entities.name: Shadow Gate
entities.description: Artifact that let Uramon travel via shadows; stolen by Toshiro.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: Man Uramon questioned; escaped and stole the Shadow Gate.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: Sent after Toshi, turned on Uramon and killed her with her camellia.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: Nezumi sent with Kiku after Toshi who turned against Uramon.

entities.name: Heart of Frost
entities.description: Place where Toshi forced Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer to join the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moon spirits who began infiltrating the swamp.

events.summary: When the soratami infiltrate the swamp, Uramon sends for Toshiro Umezawa to question him.
events.quote: she sent for Toshiro Umezawa to question him

events.summary: Toshi escapes and Uramon sends Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer after him to the Heart of Frost.
events.quote: Uramon sent Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer after him to the Heart of Frost

events.summary: Toshi forces the pair into joining the Hyozan Reckoners, and they turn against Uramon.
events.quote: they turned against their former master

events.summary: Ordered to execute Toshi, they release him and attack; Toshi steals the Shadow Gate and Kiku's camellia kills Uramon.
events.quote: the overlord herself was killed by Kiku 's camellia

relations.quote: the overlord herself was killed by Kiku 's camellia
Uramon was a worshipper of the Myojin of Night's Reach

relations.note: owned it until Toshi stole it
relations.quote: she possessed an artifact that allowed her to travel via shadows, the Shadow Gate
